sections.title: What differs and must be verified

sentences.text: Counterexample: GNAO1-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with involuntary movements) shows high phenotypic proximity but no mechanism support (P=0.98, M=0.00) and is excluded.
Overlap with CACNA1A-related disease (migraine, familial hemiplegic, 1) occurs via Regulation of insulin secretion (Reactome R-HSA-422356; M=0.11, S=0.40).
Overlap with SLC2A1-related disease (hereditary cryohydrocytosis with reduced stomatin) occurs via Regulation of insulin secretion (Reactome R-HSA-422356; M=0.08, S=0.49).

Overlap with GRIN1-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with or without hyperkinetic movements and seizures, autosomal dominant) occurs via Neurexins and neuroligins (Reactome R-HSA-6794361; M=0.06, S=0.45).
Comparator linkage: DNM1-related disease (developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 31B) overlaps via vesicle organization (GO:0035493 for STXBP1; GO:0007032 for DNM1; M=0.03, S=0.51).
Variant-effect contrast (V=0) with CACNA1A: STXBP1 predominantly loss_of_function, while CACNA1A reports gain_of_function variants.
Variant-effect contrast (V=0) with GRIN1: STXBP1 predominantly loss_of_function, while GRIN1 reports gain_of_function variants increasing NMDA receptor-mediated charge transfer.

Contradictory clinical correlations within STXBP1 evidence are indexed: no correlation between seizure severity and ID severity; no correlation between mutation type and seizure/cognitive outcomes; recurrent variants not tied to distinct electroclinical syndromes.
Ingo Helbig is a verified bridge to the comparator DNM1-related disease (developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 31B) through authorship and program roles relevant to STXBP1 and DNM1.
Sarah McKeown Ruggiero and Katherine L Helbig are additional bridges to the comparator via DNM1/STXBP1 publications with overlapping co-authorship and affiliations.

Review STXBP1 and SYNGAP1 Related Disorders Natural History Study (NCT06555965) eligibility for DNM1-related disease (developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 31B) and verify Ingo Helbig as a contact.

Comparator phenotype coverage by STXBP1 and SYNGAP1 Related Disorders Natural History Study is partial at 12% (6 of 39; IC 20.63/167.43) for DNM1-related disease (developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 31B).
